extraction_notes: All numeric values are approximate digitizations from SI plotted markers/bars and are marked '~'. I extracted SI catalytic-performance plots that directly provide CO2 conversion, methanol selectivity, CO selectivity, or methanol STY/formation rate into the available schema fields. Time-on-stream SI Figure S3 was handled using only first and last points per catalyst. Characterization/DRIFTS/TPD-only figures, oxygen-balance figures, Arrhenius/reaction-order linearization plots, equilibrium/model curves, and plots with only non-schema quantities such as DME/MF STY or CO STY without methanol STY/conversion/selectivity were not transcribed. Several very dense SI plots (notably full GHSV and some methanol-conversion side-reaction panels) contain additional non-target or non-schema product data; only representative/target-field points visible in the supplied SI page images are reported here.
